 Elon Musk says he and SpaceX plan to give every child in the US two SpaceX shares via Trump Accounts, doubling his pledge; the donation is worth ~$18.4B   —  Elon Musk and SpaceX will give every child in the US two shares in the space exploration company, doubling a commitment the world's richest person made just last month.
